note: A single MCP tool argument of 12,000,000 bytes reached the server intact: the full length arrived, the canary prefix was present and the trailing bytes were unchanged. So there is no 4.1MB ceiling: the argument is passed by the harness regardless of the telemetry maxRequestBytes default of 4,000,000.

contextGrowth.whyLarger: the follow-up model request replays the tool_use input (the 12MB argument) plus the tool result and the tool schemas, so it is larger than the tools/call request itself
contextGrowth.note: an earlier version reported the tools/call size as 12,052,319, which was the follow-up model request's size copied by mistake; the two are now reported separately

caveat: One size (12MB) and one provider mock. A ceiling may exist above this or may be imposed by a real provider; neither was tested. The wrap time was 5.3s but was not profiled.
toolsCallSource: measured on the MCP server, not derived

canaryLocation.explanation: the canary travels in the model's tool_use output and then sits in the conversation history, so it appears in the LATER model request, not in the first one
canaryLocation.notEvidenceOf: the canary being in the initial request
